name: switch-field
title: SwitchField
description: TanStack Form switch field composed with Keystone Switch behavior and UI styling hooks.

meta.customization: Use ui-switch-field classes, TanStackField shell classes, Switch classes, Core data attributes, neutral data-slot hooks, switchProps, and switchClass for generated-source styling.
meta.api: SwitchField exports SwitchField, SwitchFieldProps, and SwitchFieldValidators. It composes TanStackField with the styled Switch item, passes validators to form.Field, derives touched error state through TanStackField, maps checked changes to boolean field.handleChange, maps blur to field.handleBlur, and forwards disabled/readOnly/required/formId to Core Switch.
meta.accessibility: Backed by TanStackField for field relationships and by @keystone-ui/core/switch for role=switch, aria-checked, Space keyboard toggling, hidden checkbox submission, reset synchronization, and validation metadata. The switch control receives the shared Core form-control ID and ARIA props.
meta.state: TanStack Form owns the boolean field value, touched, dirty, blurred, validating, and errors. SwitchField treats true as checked and all other values as unchecked.
meta.limitations: Drag gestures, optimistic preference persistence, and custom inline label layouts remain app-owned composition.

parity.tanstackForm: First-class TanStack Form parity: form.Field integration, validators pass-through, boolean value binding, blur/change delegation, and touched-derived invalid/error state.
parity.baseUi: Primitive behavior is inherited through Keystone Core Switch: checked state, keyboard toggling, hidden input submission, reset, disabled/read-only guards, and data attributes.
parity.kobalte: Solid parity follows Keystone Core Switch composition with explicit generated-source field wiring.
